# swiftplot

> Small, fast charts for the browser on Canvas 2D and WebGL2: TypeScript, ESM only, no dependencies.
> Packages: `swiftplot` (with `swiftplot/charts`), `@swiftplot/react`, `@swiftplot/vue`.

Read the guide before writing code with swiftplot. Its API differs from other chart libraries: there
is no `type` prop, no `datasets` and no child components.

## Docs

- [Guide for AI coding assistants](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GusevP/swiftplot/main/llms-full.txt): which API to pick, every prop of the easy charts, data shapes, errors and their fixes, React and Vue usage, the explicit API and every mark, mistakes to avoid
- [Reference](https://swiftplot.dev/reference): every prop of each easy chart and every option of plot(), each mark, each feature and the scales

## Optional

- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GusevP/swiftplot/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each version
